selection.signal: prompt X MC of this tag
selection.mc_weight: source pThatreweight, physical relative weights, no class-balance multiplier
selection.pre_score_scope: tag-specific DATA apply selection and MC apply/efficiency population, before score cut; freeze source entry IDs and hashes
selection.mc_population_check: For training-sideband curves use true MC train/test union after the same tag apply and MC mass requirements; it must match total efficiency population. Report caps/exclusions/missing membership instead of creating new identities.

grid.source: user instruction recorded in ML request

optimal.curve: each scope independently uses its own total curve
optimal.criterion: largest unrounded finite FOM on specified grid
optimal.ties: smallest score among exact equal maxima; report all ties
optimal.nonfinite_or_nonpositive_weight: reject inconsistent input; do not silently drop or replace
optimal.all_zero_efficiencies: all FOM zero: historical first-maximum behavior retained, flag uninformative
optimal.boundary_maximum: report boundary flag; no automatic grid extension

request: User instruction: corrected flat inputs for independent PbPb18/PbPb23 ML

human_decision.authority: User requested independent 2018/2023 workflows using same recipe and each training-total optimal

wide.data_population: full DATA apply population in wide sidebands

training.sideband_source: actual tag training metadata; values shown are current approved ML route
training.membership: original training split only; no extension, no redraw of membership
training.data_population: union of true background train/test candidates, restricted to tag apply selection and actual training sidebands
training.mc_population: union of true prompt-X train/test candidates, restricted to tag MC apply selection and 3.62<m<4.00
training.epsilon_each_curve: passed physical MC weight sum within that group / pre-score physical MC weight sum within that group
training.total_definition: disjoint union train+test counted once; never average the two FOM values
training.normalization: q is original score-independent split inclusion probability; confirm actual sampling metadata; cannot use post-cut group proportions
conditions: same fixed model for all curves
true union matches eligible total population; caps or nonrandom exclusions must be reported
test is diagnostic because total is used for optimal selection
training.width_rule: target window width / sum of actual sideband widths; training mass boundaries follow model metadata and are recorded

optimal_mass_plots.population: full DATA passing same tag apply selection and the respective optimal score; no sideband/train/test restriction on mass plot
optimal_mass_plots.filename: preserve tag/data/config prefix; encode actual score immediately before semantic suffix, e.g. ...score0p77_wide_optimal.pdf and ...score0p80_optimal.pdf
optimal_mass_plots.style: reuse existing cut_scan mass range, bin width, axes, reference mass lines and plotting style
optimal_mass_plots.same_cut: keep both named outputs and both method provenance records even when cuts coincide

outputs.point_records: 91 points per curve, both independent total optima; store windows,width ratios,split identity provenance,weights and model/formula hashes
